##### Project general facts

Falcon Island is an exclusive waterfront island community that offers a rare blend of privacy, natural beauty, and refined coastal living. Surrounded by the waters of Al Hamra Village in Ras Al Khaimah, the development features an elegant collection of townhouses, semi-detached homes, and spacious four- and five-bedroom villas. Designed to embrace its island setting, Falcon Island creates a peaceful residential retreat where contemporary architecture, generous open spaces, and the surrounding waterfront come together to deliver an exceptional lifestyle.

Life on Falcon Island is centered around outdoor living and a strong sense of community. Nearly seventy percent of the island is dedicated to landscaped open spaces, offering walking tracks, green parks, sports courts, a fully equipped gym, and four swimming pools that encourage an active and relaxed lifestyle. Residents also enjoy close proximity to Al Hamra Mall, Al Hamra Marina & Yacht Club, Al Hamra Beach, prestigious resorts including Waldorf Astoria Ras Al Khaimah and The Ritz-Carlton Ras Al Khaimah, as well as schools and medical facilities, placing everyday convenience alongside world-class leisure.

The residences are thoughtfully designed to maximize space, natural light, and seamless indoor-outdoor living. From elegant townhouses to expansive waterfront villas, each home features contemporary layouts and high-quality finishes that complement the island's tranquil surroundings. Premium materials and carefully selected fittings enhance every interior, while equipped kitchens provide everyday practicality. The result is a collection of sophisticated homes that perfectly reflects the relaxed elegance and exclusive character of Falcon Island.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Hamra Village is a well-established waterfront community in Ras Al Khaimah, known for its relaxed coastal lifestyle and scenic surroundings. Set along pristine beaches and a championship golf course, the area offers a harmonious blend of natural beauty and modern living, making it a popular choice for both residents and investors.

The community features a wide range of residential options, from apartments to villas, many with views of the Arabian Gulf, lagoons, or lush fairways. It is home to key attractions such as Al Hamra Golf Club, Al Hamra Marina & Yacht Club, and a selection of hotels, restaurants, and cafés, creating a vibrant yet tranquil atmosphere.

Al Hamra Village also benefits from strong infrastructure and convenient connectivity, with easy access to Ras Al Khaimah city center and major highways. With its resort-style environment, walkable layout, and growing lifestyle offerings, it continues to evolve as one of the emirate’s most desirable residential destinations.
